name: Open DS
tagline: Every design system is a set of answers.
nameNote: The product name is pending. Change it only in this file.
urlNote: The site address (Yonatan bought open-ds.dev, 2026-10-31). Deployment is planned later; SITE_URL overrides it at build time.
contactNote: The public contact address. Mail to it is forwarded by Cloudflare Email Routing; the inbox it reaches is set there, never in this repository.
analyticsNote: Analytics is off unless the site is built with NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID set to a Google Tag Manager container ID. The ID is set in the deploy environment, never in this repository, so forks and local builds send nothing to the owner's container.
